newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai Finance Ministry staff say goodbye in poem.
newsitem.headline: Thai Finance Ministry staff say goodbye in poem.

text.p: Staff at Thailand's Ministry of Finance on Wednesday mourned the resignation of a senior official, permanent secretary for finance Chatumongkol Sonakul, with a poem.
Chatumongkol, an outspoken civil servant, resigned on Wednesday a day after being moved to an inactive post by a Thai government struggling with an economic crisis.

"Sadness and yearnings are our feelings, (it) seemed like a nightmare...We all admit you are a great finance official," read part of a poem written in English and signed with "respect, love and regret" by officials and staff of Chatumongkol's office.

"You dare to walk through the darkness and the storm, You fight like a hero, you fear no evil...We will always remember your world-wide visions, We will always remember the future you planned," it added.
Chatumongkol had a reputation as a straight-talking and abrasive administrator during his 30-year civil service career.
A government statement on Tuesday said Chatumongkol's services to society were no longer required.
Another long-serving official, Bank of Thailand Governor Rerngchai Marakanond, quit under political pressure on Monday.
